dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: *sob, sniff* ... The show was a resounding success...

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: #Our thanks to all of the actors and actresses, and our thanks to everyone who came to support us! Of course, we must thank you as well, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: I really appreciated your undivided attention... *sob*... It felt just like the relentlessly piercing gaze of the evil dragon...

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: Oh yes, the title is 'Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess'!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But she only wielded the sword for a brief moment towards the end?

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: Well... It's just like how The Five Kasen are usually portrayed in four poems...

choices.text: And like how we also call the best travel buddy "emergency food"...

response.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
response.text: Well, anyway, the important thing is not the sword in the hand, but the courage in the heart!

response.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
response.text: #Back to business! Now that the curtains have closed, I would like to take this rare opportunity to invite {NICKNAME} and Paimon to take a photo with the crew!

choices.text: And like how we have a cavalry captain without a single horse...
